_what: THE ONE LIST of video formats the Galaxy filter, the daily picks and the makers speak in. Twelve formats; every other name the repo holds (workflow.py's 60, bank.json, the elements library, routes.json) is an alias that points here. The aliases are read, not renamed: no other list is changed. Two names that make the same ad are one format here; what differs between them is a script choice, not a format. Image ads keep the creative matrix's own image format list (dimensions / elements format.image.json).
_decided: 2026-11-27, owner: 'testimonial montage and narrator montage are literally the same thing ... let's get everything really cleaned up'. Merges below are reversible: delete an alias line and the old name stands alone.

presenter.means: One person talks to the camera.
presenter.was_different: expert-consult has several experts in turn and sports-interview is a press table; both are still one person talking to a lens at a time.

demo.means: The product doing the work: hands, before and after, a step said is a step shown.
demo.was_different: remedy starts from what people used at home; the product still does the work at the end.

montage.means: A voice over a run of short shots from our footage; no one plays a character.
montage.was_different: testimonial montage uses many voices, one line each; narrator montage uses one. Same ad on the same road (our footage, no AI, the edit line). One voice or many is a script choice.

scene.means: People acting out a moment in a room, talking to each other.
scene.was_different: micro drama, skit and continuation differ in tone, not in how they are made.

short-film.means: A short wordless story, animated, no one speaks.

song.was_different: song ad and music video narrative both run on the same road (Singing Ads) and both are sung; the difference is the picture style.

stunt.means: A visual hook first (something impossible or odd), mostly no words.

throwback.means: A look back at the viewer's own era: old photo, home video, old commercial, old game.

reaction.means: A found moment (meme, clip) with our reaction cut onto it.

text-thread.means: A chat on a phone screen tells it.

explainer.means: A voice explains over drawn or animated pictures.

series.means: Three or more ads that run as one story.

methods._what: Not formats: ways an ad gets made or remade. They never appear as a format in the daily picks.
methods.winner-variation: Our Ad Multiplier: new versions of a live winner (routes.json ad-multiplier).
methods.swipe-edit: Our swipe edit: the swipe's own footage re-cut (routes.json swipe-edit).
methods.creator: A creator films it (routes.json creators). In the standard this is a LANE (creators), never a format.

from_on_screen._what: What a proven ad's winners tag (what is on screen) means in these formats. A tag with no video format is a picture ad and goes to the images lane.

lanes._what: The three things that matter: video we make (internal), video a creator films (creators), picture ads (images). A lane is where an ad is made and who takes the brief, never a format.

video-internal.means: Video we make: AI, our own footage, drawn in code, or the editor.

creators.means: Video a creator films from our brief.
creators.door: components/briefs/creator-brief/build.py (reads the ask's person and line)

images.means: Picture ads, one round at a time.

words._what: Plain words for the daily page, so a repo word never reaches the owner unexplained.
words.take: one attempt at a clip; the one kept is the one in the ad
words.swipe: someone else's ad that already works
words.teardown: an ad taken apart to see why it works
